newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain 10-yr spread vs Bunds breaks 70 basis points.
newsitem.headline: Spain 10-yr spread vs Bunds breaks 70 basis points.

text.p: The Spanish 10-year cash yield spread over Bunds fell to a new historic low in late Tuesday afternoon, breaking through 70 basis points to trade at 69 basis points, dealers said.
The previous record was broken earlier today at 75 basis points, while last Friday it had hit the level of 77 basis points. On Monday the cash German market was closed for a public holiday.
In the meantime the long bond future was trading 36 basis points higher at 116.02, with a first resistance at 116.25.
